direction: Recognizable crouched long-eared hare with haunch, paws and whiskers. Directional short knife-cut strokes translate the two-tone scratchboard art into a live native identity; soft pebble bezel, dash ticks, needle hands, column charge gauge and folio calendar retain quiet natural forms.
ornamentDirection: One open thorny bramble leaf-edge and short scratched vein strokes naturally accompany the hedgerow art in small headers. No closed button/ring or compressed full animal; larger hare heroes stay whole.
